name: Hermes Agent v0.18.0 (v2026.7.1)
summary: The Judgment Release. Over the last week and a half the team put nearly all of its effort into one goal: resolve every P0 and P1 issue and PR in the entire Hermes Agent repo — and as of this release, 100% of them are closed. Zero open P0s. Zero open P1s. That's ~700 highest-priority items cleared as part of ~1,950 total issues and PRs closed this window. We intend to keep P0/P1 at zero from here on.
